name: kubectx-crash-safe-coordinated-kubeconfig-6339
instr:
kubectx and kubens cannot commit kubeconfig documents and auxiliary selection state as one crash-safe, recoverable local outcome. Make mutations retain either the complete old or requested state after failure or interruption, with recovery on a later invocation requiring no Kubernetes API access. Preserve existing command validation, output, failure distinctions, and multi-file ownership semantics.

A coordinated commit must be atomic across all registered destinations. Success durably installs every requested content; an incomplete commit restores all prior contents and reports OutcomeRestored. Keep durable intent after commit or recovery failures. CommitError identifies the affected Path through Err. RecoverPending must deterministically resolve unfinished work using only local journals and destinations, removing intent only after terminal OutcomeCommitted or OutcomeRestored.

SaveCoordinated must preserve separate loaded kubeconfig documents, first-file precedence, and each mutation's owning destination instead of persisting merged output. Resolve pending recovery before every state-changing kubectx or kubens operation. Read-only operations must create no recovery work.

Context switching, rename, deletion, and unset must retain established validation, stopping, warning, confirmation, isolated-shell, and error-reporting behavior, with related writes sharing one recoverable outcome. Namespace switching must coordinate an actual namespace change with per-context previous-nam
